notes.title: New Patch!
notes.notes:
What's Changed?

1. The colouring of the sandstone icon has been tweaked to differentiate it a little more from the sand icon. It was easy to get confused when making glass for the first time. Hopefully this should help. 
2. Button remapping scroll view now has a sensible scroll speed when being controlled by a mouse wheel.
3. Fix for final boss not pathing correctly when playing in some regions.

We've still got a few very minor issues to patch up but if you see anything that isn't right, get in touch on the forums or come jump in our discord.

See you on the shop floor!
